title: R4 inline the contract: build prompt carries the acceptance criteria verbatim, the ACS predicate names (go test -list over go/acs/cycle<N>), and a schema-validated handoff-tdd.json replacing agent-mailbox.md as the tdd→build authority
summary: Gaps G3+G4: build-prompt.txt carries only the task slug (line 106 tells the builder to open triage-report.md then .evolve/evals/<slug>.md); the RED test names arrive via free-text agent-mailbox.md. A weaker model that skims builds against an imagined contract and nothing checks comprehension. Evidence: SWE-agent ACI (concise informative feedback beats indirection), Spec Kit / Kiro EARS testable criteria, Anthropic feature-list-as-data.
root_cause: The prompt assembler (prompts/systemprompt) inlines the persona and cycle context but not the selected item's acceptance[] or the tdd phase's predicate list; the mailbox is prose with no schema.
fix: (1) Assembler inlines acceptance[] of every top_n item verbatim in a harness-owned block; (2) after tdd, the harness runs `go test -list . -tags acs ./acs/cycle<N>` and inlines the names; (3) tdd emits handoff-tdd.json {predicates[], fix_sketch, out_of_scope[]} validated by phasecontract; the mailbox stays advisory.
acceptance: build-prompt.txt for a cycle with two top_n items contains both items' acceptance[] arrays verbatim and the ACS test names; unit test pins the block.
A tdd phase that writes no handoff-tdd.json (or an invalid one) fails the tdd contract gate loudly, not silently.
No belief duplication: acceptance text is read from the inbox item (single source) and projected.

consumed.landing: ADR-0098 — Task Contract block: acceptance[] verbatim from the bound inbox record(s) into the tdd and build prompts; ACS predicate names listed by the harness (go test -list) into the build prompt
consumed.resolution: FIXED (with one deviation, recorded in the ADR: no handoff-tdd.json — the predicate inventory is derived from the test files themselves, which is the single source the AC-Materialization table already keys on; a second agent-authored handoff file would be a second belief)
